market.question: Will the Seattle Storm make the 2026 WNBA Playoffs?

assessment.reasoning: Seattle entering rebuild — lost top-5 scorers in free agency, new head coach (Sonia Raman), reliant on rookies and 2nd-year center Malonga. WNBA expanding so playoff field competitive. Subjective season-long forecast; rebuild teams typically miss playoffs more often than not. 35-45% range.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Malonga's leap and rookie integration; how much new HC tactics translate
